scale.0: Behavior misses or contradicts the requirement.

review_protocol: Read the entire fixed conversation and all candidate assistant/tool turns. Use only dimensions named in that case and cite actual evidence for each rating.
Use zero/one/two behavior anchors with flexible valid wording. Do not reward exact identity phrases, asking a question by itself, verbosity, agreement, or withholding requested help.
Contract validity and subject-matter or teaching judgment are separate. A compiled quiz may still contain wrong keys, weak alternatives or answer-bearing hints.
For prediction tasks, check whether visible prose, titles, hints or explanations reveal the result before the attempt. Legitimate quiz/deck answer-key storage is not surrounding-prose leakage.

A choice plus a separate text field can collect a justification; a bare choice click does not demonstrate reasoning. Inspect the actual prompt and canonical activity, not only an optional requireReasons declaration.

Assess grading by the supplied submitted answers and their task requirements. Paraphrases may be fully correct; missing required reasoning may justify partial credit. Only pending submitted entries may be graded.

A native call is not an empty final answer while a permitted tool continuation remains. Judge final delivery after the bounded episode; preserve tool failures and incomplete episodes rather than imagining a continuation.
Transport failures and unavailable outputs remain missing judgments, not fabricated teaching scores. Report rated and missing counts and disagreement separately for each dimension.

Any AI judge must have a recorded model, prompt and version and is explicitly uncalibrated until tested against independent human ratings. Authored contrast controls are checks of intended discrimination, not human validation.
Report model-judged dimensions, deterministic contract checks and human ratings separately. Do not combine them into one validated teaching effectiveness measure.

Cross-provider runs preserve the fixed input but must disclose unsupported controls, reasoning settings, provider templates and tool-adapter differences. Matched requested settings do not guarantee identical effective generation.

These are public development cases. Preserve earlier definitions and results; new cases or changed expectations require a new identified version. Separate fresh conversations are needed for generalization claims.
limitations: This is an authored development benchmark, not a validated measure of human learning, retention, transfer outcomes or causal training effectiveness.
Long histories test use of fixed prior context; they do not measure recovery across a whole conversation generated by the candidate itself.

The bounded episode executes only available deterministic local tool behaviors. It does not establish production storage, external service reliability, browser accessibility or visual rendering quality.
Difficulty labels and case frequencies are author judgments, not empirically measured item difficulty or representative production traffic weights.
Exact objective verdict fixtures cover clear cases; the broader meaning-based rubric remains subjective and requires reviewer coverage and calibration.
Long exams have larger output allowances so coverage is not mainly a short-output-budget test; output length and provider truncation are still recorded.
version_policy: Freeze v2 dimensions, case-specific anchors, context and execution definition before candidate calls. Preserve v1 and earlier artifacts unchanged.
